items.stem: A team wants to reuse customer-support transcripts (collected to answer tickets) to train a new product model. What principle does this most directly challenge?

options.text: Purpose limitation: data collected for one purpose should not be freely repurposed without a basis

options.rationale: Portability concerns moving data, not reuse for training.
The issue is purpose, not security.
The challenge is a privacy principle, not accuracy.

items.provenance: original Mastemy item drafted by an AI agent; no external question source

items.stem: Which TWO statements about anonymisation for AI training data are correct? (Select TWO.)

options.text: Re-identification can sometimes occur by combining an 'anonymised' dataset with other data
options.rationale: Correct: linkage attacks are a known limit of anonymisation.

options.text: Pseudonymised data can often still be linked back and is not the same as anonymised
options.rationale: Correct: pseudonymisation is reversible and still personal data in many regimes.

options.text: Hashing email addresses always makes data fully anonymous
options.rationale: Hashing is pseudonymisation, often reversible via guessing.

options.text: Anonymised data needs no further governance ever
options.rationale: Residual re-identification risk still warrants governance.

items.explanation: Correct: linkage attacks are a known limit of anonymisation.

items.stem: A user exercises a deletion right over data that was used to train a deployed model. What is the governance-aware response?

options.text: Delete the source records and assess and document the effect on the model, following the defined process
options.rationale: Correct: rights handling must consider downstream model use, not just the database row.

options.text: Only delete the database row and ignore the model
options.rationale: Ignoring the model's use of the data is incomplete.

options.text: Refuse because the model already learned from it
options.rationale: The request cannot simply be refused by default.

options.text: Retrain on everything with no record

items.explanation: Correct: rights handling must consider downstream model use, not just the database row.
